meta.title: mkv
meta.tagline: In a realm written in blood, only one king claims the ultimate empire.
description: Following the death of Garuda, Rocky establishes himself as the undisputed ruler of the Kolar Gold Fields. As his power grows, he aims to consolidate his empire while protecting the workers who revere him as their messiah. However, his supreme rise to dominance triggers immense retaliation from dangerous rivals and powerful government authorities determined to dismantle his illegal syndicate.

Faced with threats from the ruthless Adheera, political adversaries, and military forces, Rocky must navigate relentless betrayals and intense warfare. To protect his realm and fulfill his mother's lifelong dream, he prepares for an all-out war against any force daring to challenge his reign over the gold fields.
